dictation.server.address-hint.where: Quiet line under the address field in the Server address popup
dictation.server.address-hint.about: What to type: the server computer's network name or IP address.

dictation.server.outside-network.where: Warning line under the address field in the Server address popup
dictation.server.outside-network.about: The typed address is not on the user's home network, so recorded speech would travel over the internet without encryption.

dictation.server.title.where: Title of the popup for typing a dictation server's address, over Settings
dictation.server.title.about: Dictation can use a speech recognition server the user runs on another computer; this popup asks for its address.

ime.hint.cangjie.where: Hint line under the toolbar before anything is typed, Chinese Cangjie input
ime.hint.cangjie.about: Space or the digits 1–5 pick a candidate, Enter commits, Esc cancels.
ime.hint.cangjie.keep: Keep 倉頡 (the input method's name) and the key names Space, Enter and Esc; translate select, commit and cancel.

ime.hint.flick.where: Hint line in the Japanese flick keyboard before anything is typed
ime.hint.flick.about: Which keys convert, commit and undo.
ime.hint.flick.keep: Written in Japanese for people typing Japanese: keep it exactly as it is in every language.

ime.hint.flick-digits.where: Hint line in the Japanese flick keyboard while it types digits
ime.hint.flick-digits.about: Tells Japanese typists that the あA1 key returns to kana input.

languages.additional.where: Caption over the right column's list in the Additional languages popup
languages.additional.about: The added keyboard languages, in the order the toolbar's language button switches through them.

languages.drop-to-remove.where: Note on a language row being dragged out of the Additional list
languages.drop-to-remove.about: Letting go of the dragged row removes that language from the additional languages.

languages.languages.where: Caption over the middle column of the Additional languages popup
languages.languages.about: The keyboard languages the chosen layout can type.

languages.layouts.where: Caption over the first column of the Additional languages popup
languages.layouts.about: The list of keyboard layouts (key arrangements such as QWERTY); picking one shows the languages that layout can type.

languages.main.where: Caption over the right column's top row in the Additional languages popup
languages.main.about: The keyboard language set in Settings, which the others are added to.

languages.title.where: Title of the Additional languages popup, opened from Settings
languages.title.about: Keyboard languages besides the main one, which the toolbar's language button cycles through.

output.input-not-sent.about: Key presses (not text) could not be delivered to the app; everything waiting was dropped.

output.not-queued.about: Text could not even be put in line for delivery to the app ('target'). Rare; a technical failure.

output.not-sent.about: Typing into the focused app ('target') failed. Pressing Enter on the keyboard tries the same text again.

output.not-sent-actions-discarded.about: Like 'Text not sent', and key presses and text waiting behind it were dropped. Enter on the keyboard retries the text.

output.not-sent-later-discarded.about: Typing into the focused app failed. 'Target' is the app or text field receiving the keyboard's input. Pressing Enter on the keyboard tries the text again; what was typed after it was dropped.

output.queue-full.about: Too many key presses are waiting to be delivered to the app; the last press was dropped.

output.waiting-for-delivery.about: Earlier text is still being handed to the system's text input, so the key just pressed was not sent. The user should press it again once that finishes. 'Compositor' is the system part that delivers text to apps.
